task: 1. Extract core financial metrics and key business highlights for Q1 FY24 from financial_report.pdf. 2. query_sentence: Extract financial metrics and business highlights from the financial report, compile them into an Excel analysis, and create a Word summary emphasizing Q1 performance and key divisions.
